document:0:537:0.text:
First, strip the bark from a <style="highlight">slender branch</style> with a small knife. Then sand it with fine sandpaper until the surface becomes smooth and polished to ensure safe handling during use.
Next, carve a small groove at the tip of the branch and securely tie a string to it.
Finally, attach the <style="highlight">feather</style> from Lord Edward to the end of the string.
document:0:537:0.source_cn:
首先，用小刀削去<style="highlight">细长的树枝</style>表面的粗糙树皮，用细砂纸反复打磨，直到其手感光滑温润，确保挥舞时不会划伤使用者。
其次，在树枝顶端刻出一个微小的凹槽，将一根柔韧的细绳牢牢系在其中。
最后，将那根来自爱德华公子的<style="highlight">柔软的翎羽</style>绑在细绳的末端。
